description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Pioneering Evolution, LLC builds software that automates acquisition and finance processes for federal programs. The Junior Software Engineer will contribute production code to the SyncCore platform or SyncPoint application modules, participate in design and code reviews, and progressively take ownership of features using .NET, Angular, databases, messaging, and cloud technologies.
Junior software engineer building .NET and Angular platform or module features

Responsibilities:
• You would join either the platform team or one of the module teams. Both are great places to learn, and we will talk with you about which fits best. You won’t spend your first year watching from the sidelines. You’ll write production code, participate in design discussions, review code with experienced engineers, and gradually take ownership of features as your skills grow

Requirements:
• Software development fundamentals and a working grasp of object-oriented programming
• Experience with C# or any other statically typed language. Java, Kotlin, C++, Go, TypeScript, Swift — all fine. We are hiring for how you think, not which compiler you have used
• Familiarity with relational databases and SQL
• Some understanding of web applications, HTTP, and APIs
• Exposure to JavaScript or TypeScript
• Familiarity with Git
• The ability to work a problem systematically when it does not make sense yet, and to say so out loud when it does
• Typically 0–3 years of professional experience. If you are further along and this still describes you, apply anyway and we will talk about level
• U.S. citizenship is required. No exceptions. This is a federal program requirement and we cannot waive it
• You do not need an active clearance to apply. An active Secret is welcome. If you do not have one, you need to be eligible for an interim Secret — and we sponsor
